newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-St George to set up auto finance jv.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-St George to set up auto finance jv.

text.p: St George Bank Ltd said on Thursday it plans to set up an automotive finance company joint venture with Australia's leading automotive importer, Astre Automotive Group, in which it would hold a 45 percent stake.
St George said Astre will hold 55 per cent of the new venture. The first finance packages are expected to be offered by mid year.

Astre holds the local franchises for Hyundai Motor Co Ltd , Audi AG and Jeep, which is made by Chrysler . It said Astre has about 50,000 vehicle sales for Hyundai, 8,000 for Chrysler Jeep and 3,000 for Audi.

"The projected combined turnover in automotive sales this year of more than A$1 billion gives Astre an excellent opportunity to venture into the motor-vehicle finance business in Australia," St George said.
St George said initial share capital would be about A$6 million, net operating assets A$60 million, and the debt-to-equity ratio would be 9.0 per cent.
